# AdMob & AdSense Revenue Calculator

> AdMobRevenue is a free, highly accurate forecasting engine for digital publishers and mobile app developers. The site provides a deterministic calculator to forecast Google AdMob (mobile app) ARPDAU and Google AdSense (website) Page RPM. It utilizes verified industry benchmarks, geographic tier multipliers, and ad format statistics to help developers accurately project their ad monetization income.

- Company type: Indie Developer / Free Utility
- Products: Google AdMob Revenue Calculator (Estimates app earnings using ARPDAU, Impressions, Ad Formats, and Real-Time Bidding metrics); Google AdSense Revenue Calculator (Estimates web earnings using Pageviews, Viewability, Geo-distribution, and AdBlocker rates).
- Services: Digital Monetization Forecasting, Ad Network Revenue Estimation, A/B Scenario Planning.
- Keywords: admob revenue calculator, adsense revenue calculator, mobile ad income, app earnings analysis, arpdau calculator, page rpm calculator, google ad revenue, ecpm forecasting, tier 1 ecpm, rewarded video revenue, anchor ads viewability, ad monetization tool.
